payload.title: Systematic Performance Bottleneck Analysis for LLM Inference Frameworks
payload.summary: A comprehensive methodology for diagnosing performance bottlenecks in LLM inference frameworks (SGLang, vLLM), covering a seven-layer diagnostic model from hardware to application layer, with practical tooling guidance and decision trees.

sections.heading: 1. The GPU Utilization Illusion
sections.gist: `nvidia-smi` showing 95% GPU utilization is the biggest dashboard deception in inference tuning.

sections.heading: 2. vLLM V1: The 2025 Rewrite
sections.gist: vLLM released V1 Alpha in January 2025 and made V1 the default engine in v0.8.0.

sections.heading: 3. SGLang: Running CPU Ahead of GPU
sections.gist: SGLang's core philosophy is keeping the CPU one step ahead of the GPU.

sections.heading: 4. The Seven-Layer Bottleneck Map
sections.gist: A request traverses at least seven layers from ingress to egress.

sections.heading: 5. Production Monitoring Recommendations
sections.gist: SLO should use goodput rather than raw throughput:

sections.heading: 6. Conclusion
sections.gist: Inference optimization in 2025-2026 has no silver bullets.
